capabilities.description: Enriches items that have an IMDb ID with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes critic/audience ratings via MDBList.
Enriches items that have a TMDB ID with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes critic/audience ratings via MDBList.

global_config_schema.title: MDBList
global_config_schema.description: API key from mdblist.com/preferences/#api. Ratings (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes critic + audience) are always written; gap-fill adds a few scalar fields only where TMDB/TVDB left them blank.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Your MDBList API key. Leave blank to keep the existing key.

fields.label: Gap-fill metadata fields
fields.description: In addition to ratings, fill content rating, original language, country, year, release/first-air date and (movie) runtime where another provider left them empty. Never overwrites existing data.

fields.label: Requests per second
fields.description: Throttle outbound MDBList calls to spread a backfill across your daily quota. 0 = unlimited. Useful after downgrading to a cheaper tier.

presentation.description_markdown: Community plugin by zerodayz1 (https://github.com/zerodayz1/silo-plugin-mdblist), built for Bloem on the Bloem plugin SDK.
